name: Text to simulation: a sentence, its contract, and the checks that make it a result
description: Two sentences compiled into study contracts and run through their fidelity ladder: a steel wall cooled by convection and a laminar pipe. The same nodes cover physics_ai mode, where the ladder gains a surrogate scored on designs held out of its fit (examples/intent_to_study/intent_to_study.py).

params.text: a 12 mm steel wall with k = 200 W/mK, 300 degC inside and air at 25 degC outside with h = 12 W/m2K
a 20 mm pipe, 3 m long, carrying 0.5 L/min of water, viscosity 1 mPa*s

meta.domain: text to simulation and text to physics AI
meta.notes: the numbers the script committed are in _out/summary.json; the flow runs the same two sentences through the same nodes, so the wall's cold-face temperature is the script's 572.95 K
